title: Biological activities of metal oxide nanoparticles modified with hexadeca-substituted cobalt(II) phthalocyanine bearing fluorinated substituents
content:

For the first time, the extensive DNA-cleavage, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties of the newly synthesized hexadeca-substituted metal phthalocyanine/metal oxide nanostructures are reported in this study.
